description: This is Vietnamese team. Do not enter unless you have official business here.
summary: Our team is called "Nasa Winner." We have developed a website that provides information about stars and tracks the paths of various celestial bodies. We created this platform to cater to the interests of those who are passionate about astronomy. Our goal is to ensure that the website remains a safe and engaging space for all its users.
details:
Many people are interested in NASA’s SPHEREx data, but it is highly complex, and not all of the information is useful to them. That is why we created this website

It help they access the data and make it easier for users to access exactly what they need.
